subject: Tranche-based MAP + rebate request — exec approval required
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@tranche-sys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & tranche-based rebate for pilot (TRN-4837)

Elena —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Attached is a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that maps the 12-week pilot milestones to the proposed rebate/tranche structure. High level:

- Pilot scope: NLU intent routing + embeddings for search (staging -> prod ramp)
- Milestone 1 (PO + staging integration): 10% rebate on pilot invoice
- Milestone 2 (prod rollout, 3mo commit): additional 8% rebate if committed ramp >= 50k tokens/month
- Milestone 3 (12-mo contract execution + ramp to 200k tokens/mo): additional 7% rebate and dedicated onboarding support

We're proposing the larger rebates be contingent on the commit and ramp milestones above — that keeps unit economics aligned and reduces up-front risk for Redwood.

Action items for Tranche: review MAP and confirm milestones + annual commit range so we can generate final pricing. We included an editable pricing_workbook.xlsx for your finance/legal review. If you need deeper discounts on Milestone 2, flag it here and we can route for executive approval.

Attachments: [Attachment: Tranche_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 482 KB)], [Attachment: pricing_workbook.xlsx (XLSX, 320 KB)]

Best,

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
From the Redwood Sales playbook: tranche rebates requested by customers must include a formal internal approval note that specifies the exact incremental discount, the requested duration, and the fallback pricing if milestones are not met.
From: Elena Rossi <elena@tranche-sys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tranche Legal <legal@tranche-sys.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & tranche-based rebate for pilot (TRN-4837)

Soojin —

Thanks for the MAP and the workbook. High level this is promising and aligns with what our engineering + ML infra team needs. A few quick items from finance/legal:

- Can you reduce the Milestone 2 rebate to 12% effective if we agree to a 9-month minimum commit (we were hoping to avoid a 12-month lock).
- Our CFO wants to see net invoice pricing (post-rebate) for each milestone so we can model cashflow.
- Legal asks for a short paragraph in the SOW that specifies remedies if the ramp metrics are missed (we can share a template).

If any of the concessions exceed 5% additional discount beyond your standard sheet, we will need an exec approval note. Please confirm the approval path and lead time — we are targeting a signed PO by 30 Aug.

Elena Rossi
Head of Data Platform | Tranche Systems
elena@tranche-sys.com
+44 20 7946 0821

Thanks for the context. Elena's ask (12% for M2 with a 9-month commit) would be +4% over the 8% we proposed, so it falls inside a region where we can consider escalation but need formal sign-off.

Recommendation:
- Offer an escalated path: +4% on M2 if they commit to 9 months and provide a signed PO within 10 business days.
- Require the CFO sign-off to show net pricing; we'll include post-rebate row in the workbook.
- If legal requires contractual remedies, put a service credits fallback (up to 20% of milestone value) instead of full refunds.

Soojin — can you please: (1) confirm Tranche is willing to sign within the 10-business-day window, and (2) confirm they want the service-credit fallback option? If yes, I'll draft the escalation memo for the VP/CFO.

Team —

Draft approval language below to send to Finance/Execs (I'll attach the updated workbook). Please edit and approve quickly so we can get this to Elena:

--- approval memo draft ---
Request: Approve a one-time incremental rebate of +4% on Milestone 2 (bringing M2 to 12%) for Tranche Systems if they sign a 9-month commitment and provide a PO within 10 business days.
Rationale: Increased likelihood of long-term expansion; preserves unit economics due to the commit and staged ramp.
Budget impact: Estimated $36k revenue concession over 12 months (see pricing_workbook.xlsx).
Fallback: If milestones not met, Redwood will provide service credits equal to up to 20% of the milestone invoice.
Approval required: CFO sign-off for net pricing + VP approval for discount >3%.

Attachments: [Attachment: pricing_workbook.xlsx (revised)]
---

Ben — can you add any finance commentary. Aditya — can you review and, if acceptable, sign? We need an answer by COB Mon 24 Aug to hit Tranche's target.

Laura Bennett
